passages.title: A Coastline That Could Breathe Again — Biographical Profile (Biography: Environmental Changemakers; Describing Environmental Conditions)
passages.text:
At the edge of Tanjung Sari, a low-lying coastal village, the shoreline has changed over two decades. Several stretches of mangroves were cleared to make room for fish ponds. Without dense roots to hold the mud, parts of the bank began to erode, and salt water occasionally entered wells near the coast. During high tides, small boats had to be moved farther inland.

Sinta Rahma, who grew up in the village, became interested in the problem while helping her parents sort their fishing equipment. After studying coastal ecology at a local university, she returned in 2018 and invited fishers to record where water reached during different tides. The information was used to create a simple tidal map.

The first restoration attempt was disappointing. In 2019, volunteers planted 900 seedlings in a single exposed area; fewer than 200 remained a year later. Sinta's team discovered that several species had been placed below their suitable tidal zones, where waves and water conditions were too harsh.

Before the next planting season, a tidal map was prepared with help from experienced fishers. The team selected species for different zones and protected young plants from boat traffic. Over three seasons, 2,400 seedlings were planted. Monitoring notes from three plots showed that about 70 percent remained alive after twelve months. The figure does not describe the entire coastline, but it gives the village a useful basis for improving future work.

Some families now help maintain small nurseries and report damaged seedlings after storms. Their involvement has also made the project less dependent on occasional visitors. For Sinta, restoration is not a one-day event; it is a process that depends on local knowledge and patient monitoring.

passages.title: Your Digital Identity: More Than Just a Profile — Informational Text & Formal Transactional Email (Digital Identity and Transactional Messages)
passages.text:
Every time a person posts a photograph, comments on a public discussion, or creates an account, a digital record may be formed. Some information is easy to remove, but copies can remain elsewhere. Although a profile marked "private" limits who can see future posts, it does not guarantee that old screenshots, downloaded images, or search results will disappear. This is why a digital identity should be managed as carefully as a public introduction.

Before sharing, users should check the audience, remove personal details that are not needed, and ask permission before posting someone else's image. They should also review old accounts rather than assuming that an unused profile has vanished. If a platform offers a removal process, users should follow its verification steps and keep a record of the request.

Nadia recently discovered that a public biography from a volunteer project she joined in 2023 was still searchable. She had already changed her account to private, but the old profile page remained visible. She sent this message:

Subject: Request to review an outdated profile

Dear Support Team,

I created a public profile for a volunteer project in 2023. The project has ended, and I would like the profile page removed from public search. I have changed my account visibility to private, but the old biography still appears when my name is searched.

I can provide the page address and complete the ownership-verification process if required. Please let me know whether any additional steps are needed.

Thank you for your assistance.

Regards,
Nadia

Her message is specific and polite. It explains the problem, states the requested action, and offers relevant verification without sharing a password. A clear transactional message helps the recipient understand what action is being requested.

passages.title: A Practical Guide to Building a Monthly Budget — Procedure Text (Procedure Text: Personal Budgeting)
passages.text:
Managing money requires more than knowing how much a person earns. A realistic monthly budget helps individuals understand their spending habits and make better financial decisions.

Follow these steps to create a personal budget.

1. Calculate your take-home income.
Use the money that reaches your account after required deductions, not a hoped-for bonus.

2. List fixed commitments.
Include expenses such as rent, a transport pass, or a monthly data plan. These amounts usually remain similar from month to month.

3. Estimate flexible costs.
Record expenses such as food, transport top-ups, and recreation. Use receipts or bank records from the previous month so that your estimates are realistic.

4. Choose a savings target.
It is better to set aside a modest amount consistently than to choose a large target that forces you to borrow later.

5. Allocate the remaining money.
Distribute the remaining amount across your flexible categories. Include a small amount for recreation; a budget that ignores every enjoyable activity may be difficult to maintain.

6. Track your spending weekly.
Compare actual purchases with each category limit and note any unexpected costs.

7. Review the plan at the end of the month.
If a category repeatedly exceeds its limit, identify the reason and adjust the next budget. Reduce optional spending before cutting essential costs.

Keep emergency savings separate from routine spending whenever possible, and do not count borrowed money as income. These habits make the plan more honest and easier to review.

A budget is not a punishment or a promise that every month will be identical. It is a decision-making tool. When income changes, expenses arise, or priorities shift, the plan should be revised rather than ignored. A realistic budget helps people understand where their money goes and make choices before a shortage becomes urgent.

passages.title: Why Some Cities Stay Warm After Sunset — Explanation Text (Explanation Texts)
passages.text:
On a clear day, roads, roofs, and walls receive energy from sunlight. Dark materials such as asphalt absorb much of this energy, while concrete and brick can store it. Heat is absorbed by these surfaces during the day and released slowly after sunset. As a result, built-up areas may remain warmer at night than nearby places with more vegetation.

Several features strengthen this urban heat-island effect. Buildings can block moving air between streets, while traffic, industrial activity, and air-conditioning systems release additional heat. At the same time, cities often have fewer trees and less exposed soil. Because trees release water vapour through transpiration, they cool surrounding air; when trees are removed, this natural cooling process becomes weaker.

The effect is not identical in every neighbourhood. A district with parks, shaded streets, and open soil may be cooler than a district dominated by roofs and paved parking areas. Building height, wind direction, cloud cover, and the amount of human activity also influence local temperatures.

Planting trees and creating green spaces can reduce surface temperatures and provide shade for pedestrians. Reflective roofs and well-designed ventilation can also help. These measures do not remove every source of heat, but they can reduce the amount stored and released by urban surfaces.

Researchers therefore compare measurements from different streets and times of day, instead of relying on a single temperature reading. Such comparisons show whether a change has made a measurable difference.

Understanding the process helps city planners choose solutions suited to each neighbourhood rather than applying one design everywhere.

passages.title: Sleep Is Part of Learning, Not Time Lost — Analytical Exposition (Analytical Exposition: Claims and Evidence)
passages.text:
Students sometimes treat sleep as the time left over after homework, work, and screen use. However, regular sleep should be treated as part of a learning routine, not as a reward that can be postponed. During sleep, the brain processes information and helps stabilise memories. When students repeatedly sleep too little, they may find it harder to sustain attention and recall what they have studied.

A youth centre explored this issue in a four-week survey of 120 student volunteers. Participants who kept their bedtimes within roughly the same half-hour window reported fewer daytime attention lapses than those whose bedtimes changed considerably.

The finding is relevant, but it must be interpreted carefully: the survey relied on self-reports, did not randomly assign sleep schedules, and did not measure examination results. It therefore suggests an association rather than proving that a regular bedtime directly caused better academic performance.

Some students argue that staying up late is necessary before an important test. A short period of extra revision may feel useful, but repeated sleep loss can make concentration less reliable. More hours with an open textbook do not automatically mean more learning.

Families can support consistent routines by reducing late-night distractions, while students can plan revision earlier and avoid leaving every task until the final evening. Schools can also consider whether deadlines are reasonable. If students protect a regular bedtime, they may find it easier to maintain attention during the day.

Better learning depends not only on how long students study, but also on whether their routines allow them to rest.

Because a budget that excludes all enjoyable activities may be difficult to maintain.
Because people should spend their savings every month.
questions.evidence: Include a small amount for recreation; a budget that ignores every enjoyable activity may be difficult to maintain.
questions.explanation: Teks menyarankan adanya alokasi rekreasi kecil karena anggaran yang mengabaikan semua kegiatan menyenangkan mungkin sulit dipertahankan secara konsisten.

translationId.prompt: Mengapa bacaan menyarankan agar anggaran rekreasi dalam jumlah kecil tetap dimasukkan?
choices: Karena rekreasi harus selalu mendapat dana lebih besar daripada tabungan.
Karena pengeluaran tetap tidak penting.
Karena anggaran yang mengabaikan semua kegiatan menyenangkan mungkin sulit dipertahankan.
Karena orang harus menghabiskan tabungannya setiap bulan.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly expresses a conditional recommendation based on the passage?
choices: If your income changed yesterday, you will revised the plan.
If your income changes, you should revise the plan before committing to new expenses.
If your income will change, you revised the plan.
If your income changing, you should revising the plan.
questions.evidence: When income changes, expenses arise, or priorities shift, the plan should be revised rather than ignored.
questions.explanation: Pilihan B menggunakan pola yang benar: *If + simple present, should + base verb*. Pola ini menyatakan saran yang perlu dilakukan jika kondisi tertentu terjadi.

translationId.prompt: Kalimat manakah yang menyatakan rekomendasi bersyarat secara benar berdasarkan bacaan?
choices: Jika pendapatanmu berubah kemarin, kamu akan telah merevisi rencana.
Jika pendapatanmu berubah, kamu sebaiknya merevisi rencana sebelum membuat komitmen pengeluaran baru.
Jika pendapatanmu akan berubah, kamu merevisi rencana.
Jika pendapatanmu sedang berubah, kamu sebaiknya sedang merevisi rencana.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?
choices: To describe the history of industrial development.
To explain why rural communities have more buildings.
To explain how urban heat islands develop and how their effects can be reduced.
To compare the economic conditions of different neighbourhoods.
questions.evidence: Understanding the process helps city planners choose solutions suited to each neighbourhood rather than applying one design everywhere.
questions.explanation: Teks menjelaskan proses terbentuknya urban heat island dan langkah yang dapat mengurangi dampaknya, bukan sejarah industri atau perbandingan ekonomi.

translationId.prompt: Apa tujuan utama bacaan tersebut?
choices: Menggambarkan sejarah perkembangan industri.
Menjelaskan mengapa masyarakat pedesaan memiliki lebih banyak bangunan.
Menjelaskan bagaimana pulau panas perkotaan terbentuk dan bagaimana dampaknya dapat dikurangi.
Membandingkan kondisi ekonomi berbagai lingkungan permukiman.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, how does heat contribute to warmer urban nights?
choices: Surfaces absorb solar energy during the day and release stored heat after sunset.
Trees absorb all the heat and release it into buildings.
Buildings stop sunlight from reaching the ground permanently.
Rainfall produces additional heat throughout the night.
questions.evidence: Heat is absorbed by these surfaces during the day and released slowly after sunset.
questions.explanation: Permukaan kota menyerap energi matahari pada siang hari dan melepaskan panas yang tersimpan secara perlahan setelah matahari terbenam.

translationId.prompt: Menurut bacaan, bagaimana panas menyebabkan malam hari di perkotaan tetap lebih hangat?
choices: Permukaan menyerap energi matahari pada siang hari dan melepaskan panas yang tersimpan setelah matahari terbenam.
Pohon menyerap seluruh panas dan melepaskannya ke dalam bangunan.
Bangunan secara permanen menghentikan sinar matahari mencapai tanah.
Hujan menghasilkan panas tambahan sepanjang malam.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is written in the passive voice?
choices: Buildings can block moving air between streets.
Traffic and industrial activity release additional heat.
Trees cool surrounding air through transpiration.
Heat is absorbed by these surfaces during the day and released slowly after sunset.
questions.evidence: Heat is absorbed by these surfaces during the day and released slowly after sunset.
questions.explanation: Pilihan D menggunakan passive voice dengan pola *is + past participle* (absorbed) dan *is released*. Subjek *heat* menerima tindakan.

translationId.prompt: Kalimat manakah yang menggunakan bentuk passive voice?
choices: Bangunan dapat menghalangi udara bergerak di antara jalan-jalan.
Lalu lintas dan kegiatan industri melepaskan panas tambahan.
Pohon mendinginkan udara di sekitarnya melalui transpirasi.
Panas diserap oleh permukaan tersebut pada siang hari dan dilepaskan secara perlahan setelah matahari terbenam.

questions.prompt: What do the words "These measures" in the fourth paragraph refer to?
choices: Building height and wind direction only.
Planting trees, creating green spaces, using reflective roofs, and improving ventilation.
Increasing traffic and industrial activity.
Removing all vegetation from urban neighbourhoods.
questions.evidence: Planting trees and creating green spaces can reduce surface temperatures and provide shade for pedestrians. Reflective roofs and well-designed ventilation can also help. These measures
questions.explanation: These measures merujuk pada langkah-langkah yang baru disebutkan: menanam pohon, membuat ruang hijau, menggunakan atap reflektif, dan memperbaiki ventilasi.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang dirujuk oleh kata "These measures" pada paragraf keempat?
choices: Hanya ketinggian bangunan dan arah angin.
Menanam pohon, membuat ruang hijau, menggunakan atap reflektif, dan memperbaiki ventilasi.
Meningkatkan lalu lintas dan kegiatan industri.
Menghilangkan seluruh vegetasi di lingkungan perkotaan.

questions.prompt: Besides dark building materials, which factor can strengthen the urban heat-island effect?
choices: An increase in natural forest areas.
A decrease in human activities.
Waste heat released by traffic, industries, and air-conditioning systems.
A reduction in the number of paved surfaces.
questions.evidence: traffic, industrial activity, and air-conditioning systems release additional heat.
questions.explanation: Kendaraan, kegiatan industri, dan sistem pendingin udara melepaskan panas tambahan sehingga memperkuat efek pulau panas perkotaan.

translationId.prompt: Selain bahan bangunan berwarna gelap, faktor apa yang dapat memperkuat efek pulau panas perkotaan?
choices: Peningkatan luas hutan alami.
Penurunan aktivitas manusia.
Panas buangan yang dilepaskan oleh lalu lintas, industri, dan sistem pendingin udara.
Pengurangan jumlah permukaan beraspal.

questions.prompt: The word "released" in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to ...
choices: given off.
collected permanently.
hidden underground.
converted into rainfall.
questions.evidence: Heat is absorbed by these surfaces during the day and released slowly after sunset.
questions.explanation: Dalam konteks ini, *released* berarti dilepaskan atau dikeluarkan. Kata tersebut berlawanan dengan disimpan secara permanen.

translationId.prompt: Kata "released" pada paragraf pertama memiliki makna paling dekat dengan ...
choices: dilepaskan.
dikumpulkan secara permanen.
disembunyikan di bawah tanah.
diubah menjadi hujan.

questions.prompt: What is the function of the clause beginning with "Because" in the second paragraph?
choices: To introduce an opposing argument.
To describe a sequence of unrelated events.
To introduce a comparison between two cities.
To explain the reason trees can cool surrounding air.
questions.evidence: Because trees release water vapour through transpiration, they cool surrounding air
questions.explanation: Klausa yang diawali *because* menjelaskan sebab. Pohon melepaskan uap air melalui transpirasi sehingga membantu mendinginkan udara di sekitarnya.

translationId.prompt: Apa fungsi klausa yang diawali kata "Because" pada paragraf kedua?
choices: Memperkenalkan argumen yang berlawanan.
Menggambarkan urutan peristiwa yang tidak berkaitan.
Memperkenalkan perbandingan antara dua kota.
Menjelaskan alasan pohon dapat mendinginkan udara di sekitarnya.

questions.prompt: Which city-planning strategy is most consistent with the passage?
choices: Replacing all green spaces with concrete parking areas.
Creating shaded green spaces and using reflective roofs with suitable ventilation.
Increasing the number of vehicles in densely populated areas.
Removing trees to allow more sunlight to reach buildings.
questions.evidence: Planting trees and creating green spaces can reduce surface temperatures and provide shade for pedestrians. Reflective roofs and well-designed ventilation can also help.
questions.explanation: Strategi yang sesuai adalah memperbanyak ruang hijau dan tempat teduh, serta memakai atap reflektif dan ventilasi yang baik. Strategi lain justru dapat memperburuk panas perkotaan.

translationId.prompt: Strategi perencanaan kota manakah yang paling sesuai dengan bacaan?
choices: Mengganti seluruh ruang hijau dengan area parkir beton.
Membuat ruang hijau yang teduh dan menggunakan atap reflektif dengan ventilasi yang sesuai.
Menambah jumlah kendaraan di kawasan padat penduduk.
Menghilangkan pohon agar lebih banyak sinar matahari mencapai bangunan.

questions.prompt: What is the author's main argument?
choices: Regular sleep should be considered an important part of an effective learning routine.
Students should spend every evening studying until midnight.
Academic performance depends entirely on the number of textbooks students own.
Students should avoid completing homework before examinations.
questions.evidence: However, regular sleep should be treated as part of a learning routine, not as a reward that can be postponed.
questions.explanation: Argumen utama penulis adalah tidur yang teratur harus menjadi bagian dari rutinitas belajar yang efektif, bukan kegiatan yang ditunda sampai semua tugas selesai.

translationId.prompt: Apa argumen utama penulis?
choices: Tidur teratur harus dianggap sebagai bagian penting dari rutinitas belajar yang efektif.
Siswa harus belajar setiap malam hingga tengah malam.
Prestasi akademik sepenuhnya bergantung pada jumlah buku pelajaran yang dimiliki.
Siswa sebaiknya tidak menyelesaikan pekerjaan rumah sebelum ujian.

questions.prompt: Which statement represents the evidence presented in the youth centre survey?
choices: Every student who sleeps early receives excellent examination results.
All students have exactly the same sleeping habits.
Students with more consistent bedtimes reported fewer daytime attention lapses.
Students who study at night never experience concentration problems.
questions.evidence: Participants who kept their bedtimes within roughly the same half-hour window reported fewer daytime attention lapses than those whose bedtimes changed considerably.
questions.explanation: Bukti survei menunjukkan bahwa peserta dengan waktu tidur yang lebih konsisten melaporkan lebih sedikit gangguan perhatian pada siang hari. Teks tidak menyatakan semua peserta memperoleh nilai ujian tinggi.

translationId.prompt: Pernyataan manakah yang mewakili bukti dalam survei pusat remaja tersebut?
choices: Setiap siswa yang tidur lebih awal memperoleh hasil ujian yang sangat baik.
Semua siswa memiliki kebiasaan tidur yang persis sama.
Siswa dengan waktu tidur lebih konsisten melaporkan lebih sedikit gangguan perhatian pada siang hari.
Siswa yang belajar pada malam hari tidak pernah mengalami masalah konsentrasi.

questions.prompt: Why does the author avoid claiming that the survey proves regular sleep directly causes better academic performance?
choices: The survey included too many schools and examination results.
It relied on self-reports, did not randomly assign sleep schedules, and did not measure examination results.
The participants were professional athletes rather than students.
The survey lasted several years and included medical experiments.
questions.evidence: the survey relied on self-reports, did not randomly assign sleep schedules, and did not measure examination results.
questions.explanation: Penulis berhati-hati karena survei menggunakan laporan diri, tidak membagi peserta secara acak ke jadwal tidur tertentu, dan tidak mengukur hasil ujian. Karena itu, hubungan sebab-akibat belum terbukti.

translationId.prompt: Mengapa penulis tidak menyatakan bahwa survei tersebut membuktikan tidur teratur secara langsung menyebabkan prestasi akademik yang lebih baik?
choices: Survei mencakup terlalu banyak sekolah dan hasil ujian.
Survei bergantung pada laporan peserta, tidak menetapkan jadwal tidur secara acak, dan tidak mengukur hasil ujian.
Pesertanya adalah atlet profesional, bukan siswa.
Survei berlangsung selama beberapa tahun dan mencakup eksperimen medis.

questions.prompt: Why does the author mention that some students believe staying up late is necessary before an important test?
choices: To prove that sleeping is unnecessary during examination periods.
To introduce an unrelated discussion about school schedules.
To suggest that students should always study throughout the night.
To acknowledge an opposing viewpoint before explaining its limitations.
questions.evidence: Some students argue that staying up late is necessary before an important test.
questions.explanation: Penulis mengakui pandangan yang berlawanan sebelum menjelaskan keterbatasannya. Ini merupakan cara menghadirkan counterargument dalam teks argumentatif.

translationId.prompt: Mengapa penulis menyebutkan bahwa sebagian siswa menganggap begadang diperlukan sebelum ujian penting?
choices: Untuk membuktikan bahwa tidur tidak diperlukan selama masa ujian.
Untuk memperkenalkan pembahasan yang tidak berkaitan tentang jadwal sekolah.
Untuk menyarankan agar siswa selalu belajar sepanjang malam.
Untuk mengakui sudut pandang yang berlawanan sebelum menjelaskan keterbatasannya.

questions.prompt: What does the word "may" communicate in the sentence "they may find it harder to sustain attention"?
choices: A possibility rather than an absolute certainty.
An event that has already happened.
A compulsory instruction.
A condition that is impossible to change.
questions.evidence: they may find it harder to sustain attention and recall what they have studied.
questions.explanation: Modal *may* menyatakan kemungkinan, bukan kepastian mutlak. Penulis tidak mengatakan bahwa semua siswa pasti mengalami kesulitan.

translationId.prompt: Apa makna kata "may" dalam kalimat "they may find it harder to sustain attention"?
choices: Suatu kemungkinan, bukan kepastian mutlak.
Peristiwa yang sudah terjadi.
Instruksi yang wajib dilakukan.
Kondisi yang mustahil diubah.

questions.prompt: Which additional research would most strengthen the author's argument?
choices: A survey asking students which subjects they dislike most.
An informal discussion about students' favourite bedtime activities.
A larger study that tracks sleep patterns and objectively measures attention over time while considering other relevant factors.
A list of the most popular mobile phone applications.
questions.evidence: The finding is relevant, but it must be interpreted carefully: the survey relied on self-reports, did not randomly assign sleep schedules, and did not measure examination results.
questions.explanation: Penelitian lanjutan yang lebih kuat perlu mengamati pola tidur dan mengukur perhatian secara objektif dalam jangka waktu tertentu, sambil mempertimbangkan faktor lain yang relevan.

translationId.prompt: Penelitian tambahan manakah yang paling memperkuat argumen penulis?
choices: Survei yang menanyakan mata pelajaran yang paling tidak disukai siswa.
Diskusi informal tentang kegiatan sebelum tidur yang disukai siswa.
Penelitian lebih besar yang melacak pola tidur dan mengukur perhatian secara objektif dari waktu ke waktu sambil mempertimbangkan faktor relevan lainnya.
Daftar aplikasi telepon genggam yang paling populer.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly expresses a conditional idea based on the passage?
choices: If students protected a regular bedtime, they may finds it easier to concentrate.
If students protect a regular bedtime, they may find it easier to maintain attention.
If students protects a regular bedtime, they might finding it easier to maintain attention.
If students will protect a regular bedtime, they may found it easier to concentrate.
questions.evidence: If students protect a regular bedtime, they may find it easier to maintain attention during the day.
questions.explanation: Pilihan B menggunakan pola yang benar: *If + simple present, may + base verb*. Bentuk subjek jamak *students* diikuti *protect*, lalu modal *may* diikuti kata kerja dasar *find*.

translationId.prompt: Kalimat manakah yang menyatakan gagasan bersyarat berdasarkan bacaan secara benar?
choices: Jika siswa menjaga waktu tidur teratur, mereka mungkin menemukan lebih mudah untuk berkonsentrasi.
Jika siswa menjaga waktu tidur teratur, mereka mungkin lebih mudah mempertahankan perhatian.
Jika siswa menjaga waktu tidur teratur, mereka mungkin sedang menemukan lebih mudah untuk mempertahankan perhatian.
Jika siswa akan menjaga waktu tidur teratur, mereka mungkin telah menemukan lebih mudah untuk berkonsentrasi.

questions.prompt: Which conclusion best represents the author's position?
choices: Academic success is determined only by the number of hours spent studying.
Students should completely stop using technology.
Sleep is unrelated to concentration and memory.
Effective learning requires a balance between studying and maintaining healthy routines that allow sufficient rest.
questions.evidence: Better learning depends not only on how long students study, but also on whether their routines allow them to rest.
questions.explanation: Kesimpulan yang tepat adalah belajar efektif memerlukan keseimbangan antara kegiatan belajar dan kebiasaan sehat yang memberi kesempatan untuk beristirahat.

translationId.prompt: Kesimpulan manakah yang paling mewakili posisi penulis?
choices: Keberhasilan akademik hanya ditentukan oleh jumlah jam belajar.
Siswa harus sepenuhnya berhenti menggunakan teknologi.
Tidur tidak berhubungan dengan konsentrasi dan ingatan.
Belajar efektif membutuhkan keseimbangan antara belajar dan kebiasaan sehat yang memungkinkan istirahat cukup.
